instructions: Review each item under `## Failing checks` and decide whether it needs a code change.
Triage every failure under `## Failing checks` — read its included log excerpt first. See "CI failure triage" in the pr-shepherd skill for `gh run view` / `gh run rerun` rules.
If you changed code, commit any remaining changes and push. Otherwise, do not commit or push.

For any substantial decision or rejection, append `- <decision>` to Shepherd Journal with `pr-shepherd apply journal 42 '- <decision>'`. See "Shepherd Journal" in the pr-shepherd skill for citation conventions.
`[FIX_CODE]` is non-terminal. After completing these steps, rerun this command to continue.
